reviews.text:
We took our chinchilla to the emergency vet, and we couldn't be happier with the service.
The vet, Evelio, is a very kind, attentive, and friendly young man, and you can tell he truly cares about your pet. The treatment Perla, my chinchilla, received was outstanding, and she came out as good as new. I would recommend them without hesitation.

I wanted to express my gratitude for Alvaro's professionalism. On the 6th, I took my lovebird to him because we found him circling and he was diagnosed with a possible stroke. We had zero hope and a very poor prognosis. Alvaro was clear and very caring throughout. Yesterday, the 9th, he went home, maintaining his balance and eating. Now we'll see how he progresses, but in terms of the treatment and experience with this worker, it was a 10/10. He kept us calm at all times in such a difficult situation. Thank you so much for the care we received and for taking such good care of my little bird!
They are very attentive and treat our pets very well.
Very attentive and professional.
Without a doubt, excellent service, a great place to take your pet, highly recommended. Evelio personally helped me, and I'm delighted. Thank you so much for your attention.
Evelio helped us and was super friendly and professional.

First visit to Selvática and a fantastic experience! We took our guinea pig for its first check-up and Evelio was our vet. Everything was great, he was very friendly and explained everything in detail to the kids, answering all their questions and doubts.
Great customer service by the part of the team! I got attended by Evelio, he was very kind and nice, thanks for the service 💗 …

They saved my guinea pig's life! They are the best veterinarians I've ever seen—understanding, kind, and very polite. The best clinic for exotic animals! I highly recommend them because my pet is healthy today thanks to them ❤️😊😊😊 …
We're so glad we went to them because they saved my beloved Lana. Evelio, the vet who treated her, is also wonderful. We'll definitely be back.
Highly recommended clinic – fast and professional. We're not from Valencia, and they made it incredibly easy for us to get our pet treated. Sonsoles is wonderful.

Excellent service. Everyone is very friendly, but what really stands out is how well they treat all the animals. We had a minor scare with our hamster, which they handled efficiently and quickly. Very professional.

Our tortoise, "Torti," suffered a severe head injury, and we took her to Clinica Selvatica. From the very first moment, the treatment, attention, and care have been excellent.
Thanks to Evelio's guidance and advice throughout this process, we've been making progress, and now we're hopeful that she'll recover. Many thanks to Evelio and the entire team there.
An excellent team, both in their care of the animals and their interactions with people. They are polite, courteous, and very kind. Thank you.

I have no words to describe how happy, calm, and grateful I am that my little cotton ball's life was saved, especially to Alejandro, the vet who was with Blue and saved his life. He's so kind and professional (I know all vets are professional, but I have to say it and thank him for his excellent work). Thank you so much for everything you've done for him, from the bottom of my heart. ❤️❤️❤️❤️
You are the best, you are an amazing team.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Claudia!

We took a rescued sparrow that had a serious accident, and the care and attention were impeccable. Evelio, the staff member, was very professional and attentive. We thought it wouldn't make it, but it improved tremendously and is as good as new. Thank you so much! Highly recommended; they have extensive experience with exotic animals.

Álvaro and Evelio are such wonderful people. It's so amazing to be able to trust a vet so much; whenever we've had to leave Céfiro with them, they've been incredibly attentive. They told me they'd call at nine, and at nine o'clock sharp they were already calling to give me an update. They never leave me hanging, anxiously asking how my little one is doing. Thank you so much, it's truly a pleasure to have such good service. 🫂

Our almost 8-year-old guinea pig had to have surgery. We felt very well informed and supported in the decision, and the surgery went great. Thank you for everything, especially for giving us some extra quality time with our pet.

Eternally grateful to Selvática Veterinary Clinic! 🐾❤️ Last Thursday, we went through some very difficult times when our bunny Lolita suffered an intestinal blockage that lasted all weekend. In situations like this, fear is overwhelming, but we were incredibly lucky to be in the best possible hands. We want to highlight the professionalism, care, affection, and empathy shown by all the staff, both to Lolita and to us. We felt supported, comforted, and loved at all times. A huge thank you to our veterinarian, Álvaro, who is an incredible professional, deeply humane and caring; he kept us informed with the utmost rigor and calm at every step of the process. Thanks to his excellent work, Lolita has been home since Sunday, perfectly healthy, and eager to play, jump, and eat. We recommend this clinic 100%. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to the entire team! 🙏✨
I took my parakeet in for a leg injury, got an appointment quickly, and the service was excellent. Plus, if you have any questions, they respond super fast via WhatsApp. Highly recommended.

I'm Bea, Ramiro's mom. I wish I had met you sooner. It's 80 km away, but I would go back as many times as necessary. You're a fantastic team, you treat pets very well, and the work you do is simply unbeatable. The way you treated my pet and me was exceptional. Thank you so much for everything, and a big hug to the whole team!

They were great to work with. They trimmed my African Grey's nails and shortened his beak in less time than it took me to have a coffee.
The only downside was that even though we had an appointment, they didn't see us for over an hour, but you can see they're in no hurry to visit and explain things about our pets.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Roberto!

I want to sincerely congratulate and thank Evelio for the care and treatment he gave Coco 🥹❤️. From the very first moment, he was incredibly kind, approachable, patient, and above all, his love and respect for animals was evident.

In a situation that has been very worrying and distressing for me, finding such a compassionate veterinarian, who patiently explains everything and genuinely cares about his patient's well-being, has meant so much. 🐦💛

Thank you, Evelio, for your dedication, your empathy, and for making a difficult situation a little more bearable. Coco and I are so grateful to you. 🥰

Without a doubt, a professional I would recommend without hesitation. Thank you for everything! 🦜💛
I am very grateful for the kindness and attention to detail from the staff and delighted with Álvaro and the way he treated my dear Frida. I recommend it 100%.
Very good 👍 …
Thank you so much for your feedback, Diego!
Thank you so much for your feedback! :)
Thank you so much for your feedback, Jesus! We're here for whatever you need.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the Selvática Veterinary Clinic for their professionalism, dedication, and above all, the love with which you cared for Miki these past few days.

This week we had to take our little budgie, Miki, who was barely 20 days old. Unfortunately, despite all our efforts, he ultimately couldn't stay with us.

I want to especially thank Alejandro for the loving, gentle, and humane way he treated Miki. In such a difficult time, he made us feel supported and at ease, knowing he was in the best hands.

Sometimes, no matter how hard we try, we can't save them. But finding professionals who fight for them, who care for them with love, and who also care about those of us on the other side is priceless.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you did for Miki.
Excellent service. Prompt appointment.

Eternally grateful to this clinic for taking such good care of my Brownie. We took my rabbit in for an emergency due to digestive arrest caused by a dental problem,
which they were able to detect and treat from the very first minute. It's clear they are professionals and know how to handle each case. We came desperately from Castellón and kept her at this clinic for almost a week. Both morning and night they gave us daily updates and sent us photos and videos of our little bunny. I'm absolutely certain that no other clinic would have treated her so exceptionally well.
Now she's slowly recovering at home with her brother.
As I said, I don't know how to thank them enough for everything they did for her. Many thanks to Evelio and his colleagues for bringing our Brownie back to us healthy.

Taking a small bird like a budgie to the vet isn't always understood by those around you.
Rodri was lucky enough to find his trusted veterinarian.
From the very first appointment, Sonsoles diagnosed his problem perfectly. She didn't just focus on the illness, but also guided me with her advice on how to improve his care.
Thank you so much, Sonsoles, for the love and care you're giving my little one.
If you have exotic animals, I highly recommend them. They have a gentleness and passion that's hard to describe; my tortoise definitely has an official vet now.

I couldn't be more grateful to the entire clinic team, especially Evelio, who treated my cockatiel, Chispi, incredibly well. They kept me informed of her progress both morning and night, and they managed to save her after she was very ill. Before bringing her home, they explained the entire medication process, etc. In short, I am very grateful for everything, from the service to the care they showed the animals.

We're giving it 5 stars because there aren't any more.

Thank you to the entire Selvatica team, to everyone who has met little Cuca... thank you to Alvaro for helping us and treating Cuca so well when we went to the emergency room.

But above all, thank you to Sonsoles, thank you for saving her life when the egg was infestation, thank you for fighting for her until the very end and for helping us. You are a wonderful professional and person, and we apologize for the bites. Cuca will never forget you, and neither will we. From Ainhoa ​​and Andrea 🪶❤️
💚 Thank you so much, Miriam! We truly appreciate your feedback. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us 🐾✨ …

Excellent service.
Very professional.
100% recommended
Thank you so much for your feedback, Yasmin!
Thank you for your feedback, Carolina!

We took our guinea pig Dodi for the first time and Víctor took care of us. He explained everything really well and answered all our questions perfectly. A true professional. Thank you for your service.

I want to thank Jose for taking such good care of us. I'm so grateful for his attention; he explained everything perfectly. We brought in a magpie that's doing much better now, and we hope to be able to release it soon.

Thank you so much!! 🤗

I took my guinea pig Splinter to the emergency vet, and Evelio treated us. We had to admit her because she was very ill, but thanks to his care, she's doing very well now. They have a wonderful way with all the animals, explaining everything thoroughly and helping them all recover. The whole team is fantastic and very empathetic. 100% recommended.

I will always be grateful to them; they literally saved my cockatiel's life when she was in critical condition.
They are an amazing team and incredible professionals! Thank you so much! 🫂🐦
I brought Espeto, my rat, and they treated me wonderfully. The receptionist was lovely, and the guy who looked after my rat was super focused and also super friendly.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Mayte!
We went to the emergency vet because my lovebird had a prolapse due to chronic egg-laying. Thanks to the speed, care, and sensitivity of the team, especially Sonsoles, everything turned out well.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Tania!
Excellent service and professionalism. My daughter and I came, and she loved how they treated her bunnies. Thank you!
I went for my lovebird's annual check-up and everything was great! Evelio is very friendly and does an excellent job. Thank you so much!!
Excellent service, the vet was very kind and knowledgeable; my parrot is recovering thanks to them.

They're great. Especially Evelio, a really nice guy who's helping us with our parakeet. We've been taking her there for six years and everything's been wonderful. Very competent and understanding, we're delighted with him. The receptionist was very friendly too.

A unique experience, exceptional service, top-notch attention, optimal empathy, and spectacular treatment of animals. I recommend this clinic 100%. They are uniquely effective and treat your pet with wonderful gentleness. Well, I have no more words to say except that you should go to this clinic.

Everyone is professional, but I personally want to mention Evelio, who treated my pet. And the results were excellent. A big hug and blessings to this wonderful family dedicated to the care of our feathered and furry friends. 🐰🐢🐇🦔🐁🐤🦜💞🫂
Professionalism, kindness, empathy, advice, and care for my "feathers" by Dr. Evelio and the entire team: 10/10. Totally recommended!!!...Thank you for your work for and with them.

We couldn't be more grateful to Clínica Selvática and, especially, to the veterinarian Evelio. Our lovebirds, Corazón and Perrys, were in heat, and living together had become very difficult. Thanks to Evelio's treatment and recommendations, the change has been incredible. Now they get along wonderfully, are much calmer and more affectionate, and are back to being truly loving.

Besides being a great professional, Evelio is a very approachable, kind, and empathetic person. He always greets us with a smile, explains everything very clearly, and conveys a tremendous sense of calm, something that is so appreciated when it comes to the health of our little ones. It's clear that he loves his profession and is genuinely committed to the well-being of each animal.

The trust he inspires is absolute; we only want him to be the one to care for Corazón and Perrys. We wholeheartedly recommend Clínica Selvática to anyone looking for an exotic animal veterinarian with exceptional compassion and dedication. Thank you so much, Evelio, for taking such good care of our little ones!

We want to thank Clínica Selvática and, especially, veterinarian Evelio 🤗 for the exceptional care he has given our lovebirds, Corazón and Perrys. From the very first moment, he has demonstrated tremendous professionalism, dedication, and genuine affection for the birds. He takes the time to examine every detail, explain the diagnosis, and answer all our questions with patience and kindness. It's clear he loves his work and that his patients' well-being is his priority.

The confidence he inspires in us is so great that we only want Evelio to care for our little ones. Knowing that Corazón and Perrys are in his hands gives us complete peace of mind. We wholeheartedly recommend Clínica Selvática to anyone looking for a committed, attentive exotic animal veterinarian with extraordinary compassion. Thank you so much for your excellent work!

A month ago, we called the emergency vet one night to get Mango seen. She was hospitalized with a poor prognosis.

After a few days, feeling a bit better, we were able to bring her home.
Today was her first day off medication since that night, as we await her next check-up.
We just want to thank the entire Selvatica team for always being transparent, loving, and attentive to our little Mango, especially Álvaro, Sonsoles, and the ultrasound technician (whose name we can't remember), who took such good care of her 💚
Mango is surely grateful deep down. Here's a photo of her from yesterday receiving her last dose of medication 🥰

Eternally grateful to Clínica Selvática in Valencia and to Evelio. Our budgie had been suffering from feather plucking for nine months, and although other clinics treated us well, they couldn't find the solution after many tests and medications. Evelio demonstrated his great expertise with birds, correctly diagnosed my budgie, and saved him. His clinical eye makes all the difference.

A very positive experience on my first visit to the clinic. I took my guinea pig in for a check-up, and Álvaro attended to me. He was very kind and professional from the start. He inspired confidence, answered all my questions, and treated my pet with great care and affection. I appreciate the attention I received and the interest shown in my guinea pig's well-being. I highly recommend the clinic for its friendly and professional service.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Andy!
Excellent experience and service. Very friendly and professional staff. Highly recommended for visiting with exotic animals; in my case, an Amazon parrot.

I couldn't be more grateful and happy. They filed my pig's teeth and hooves at my home. Bissum is very difficult to deal with strangers. Thank you for your patience, professionalism, care, and aftercare. I have definitely found the best clinic. What peace of mind from now on! I'd been searching for years and no one wanted to treat a Vietnamese pot-bellied pig. Thank you so much!
Super friendly. I recommend it.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Alyona!
Excellent professionals. Excellent facilities. Always serving with a smile.

I've been a client for over a year, coming here for my animals' treatment. I'm truly delighted with how they're treated, which is the most important thing, and especially with Sonsoles's approach. She explains everything so well and is so skilled and good at what she does; it's a pleasure.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Sonsoles ❤️
Thank you so much for your feedback, Guillermo! :)
Thank you so much for your feedback, Sergio! :)

I'm very happy with the treatment I received, both personally and for my guinea pig. They were very helpful and attentive, and my guinea pig has recovered. Thank you so much for everything and excellent service! 10/10
The care my turtle received was very good....

Excellent clinic. I took my lovebird there in an emergency and they attended to him very quickly. They immediately performed the necessary tests and administered the required medication. They also explained the treatment plan, the most suitable diet for your pet, and everything else in great detail. Thanks to them, Mango is still with us. The staff is very friendly and clearly loves their work. I am eternally grateful for them saving my little one; I highly recommend them.

I was delighted with Evelio's care today when he treated my hamster for a lump on his eyelid. He handled it very gently and explained the treatment very clearly.
Very professional, I highly recommend the clinic.

Thanks to the veterinarian Evelio, he's been a wonderful person and a fantastic vet. He explained everything calmly and with great understanding. He diagnosed my guinea pig very quickly and provided the best possible treatment and care for the animal.
Excellent service and very professional. I recommend them.

Hi, I don't usually leave reviews, but I think it's important this time for future pets... Last Friday I went to Selvätica with my guinea pig. It was an emergency, and all the exotic animal vets were fully booked and couldn't see me, but they, despite not having any openings, saw me and were incredibly kind to both me and my little one, which is exactly what we need in a situation like that. From the moment I called, the receptionist's interest and attention to my little one was impeccable; I knew from the start that she was going to be in good hands. We arrived around 6:15 pm and left at 9 pm with the whole problem explained and with medication provided by them until I could get it the next day.

And as if that weren't enough, today, Monday, Sonsoles, the vet who treated Mani, asked me how my weekend was and how she was feeling... incredible... I've never felt so cared for and well treated with my little one, thank you from the bottom of my heart, I don't know what I would have done without you all 🥹🙏🏻♥️
Evelio took great care of my rabbit, super fast and professional. Thank you!

This is our trusted clinic. We've been taking our pets (chickens, roosters, ducks, etc.) there for years and we're always happy with the care. It's true it's not cheap, but the service is excellent! I 100% recommend this vet clinic…

Not one star.

I took my 8-year-old tortoise to them, trusting them completely, and after many tests, they gave a completely wrong and drastic diagnosis, insisting that it needed complicated surgery. It didn't need it, and they were wrong about the diagnosis.

We're talking about the health and well-being of a living being. This is very serious.

April 2026

I had never owned an exotic animal before, nor had I ever been to an exotic animal clinic, and I'm so glad I chose you. I took my guinea pig in on a Monday morning for an emergency because she had been lethargic and unresponsive since Sunday. They ran tests, including x-rays, ultrasound, and complete blood work, and she was hospitalized until today, Wednesday, when we were discharged. I want to clarify that they told me the prognosis was guarded; obviously, neither they nor I knew if she would be able to overcome the onset of sepsis she was experiencing. Two days later, after many antibiotics, painkillers, baby food, and lots and lots of pampering and care, I finally have Ratona/Enana back home with me. I have no words to thank you for what you have done for her. Thank you, Evelio, for handling her case, and thank you to the entire team. My little fighter.
Wonderful service. Everyone was incredibly attentive and professional. We couldn't have left our gecko in better hands.
Professionals in every sense. Evelio took care of our parakeet and was incredibly affectionate with our Pepito, and his treatment was spot on. Everything was perfect!
Excelent service and genuine care. Thank you Solanso and Selvätica!

I went in because my lovebird had an eye problem, and they were really great.
They gave him treatment for a week, and at the next appointment, my Kiwito was perfectly fine 😁
They are very attentive and professional.
I was seen by Evelio Hoyos Iborra.
A very good veterinarian.

And Julio, the receptionist...
A kind and polite person. Greetings to them.

We are very grateful for the treatment we received at Selvätica. Our bunny needed a complicated surgery and, from the very beginning, we felt accompanied and in very good hands.
Throughout her hospital stay, the treatment has been very close, human and professional. They have informed us very carefully, have given us confidence and have treated our bunny with enormous love and dedication.
Thank you to the entire team for taking such good care of her and for helping her recover. We are very grateful for your work and for the sensitivity with which you treat both the animals and their families.
You are a trustworthy veterinary clinic, with an excellent team. Thank you very much for everything!
Hello, my name is Estela. I am delighted with the care and service I received. Thank you, Álvaro. My lovebird is doing very well. We both thank you. I highly recommend the heart clinic.

Words cannot express our gratitude enough. Thank you so much for what you've achieved with Loca. We had no hope... I know there's still a long way to go with her, but seeing her like this, already eating and more alert, has filled us with so much joy, and now I know she's going to pull through... You guys are a great team, keep it up! Congratulations!

The care has always been incredible. I've been going to them for years, and this past year my guinea pig was very sick. Álvaro, Sonsoles, and Evelio have been amazing, constantly attentive, and incredibly kind.
Highly recommended! The attention, dedication, and care are greatly appreciated!

Excellent service, very attentive to the progress and monitoring of my child's condition.
Special mention for Evelio, a 10 out of 10 for his professionalism and personal qualities, not forgetting the rest of his team, all highly professional. Highly recommended.

I am so grateful to this veterinary clinic for the care I received.

From the very first moment, they demonstrated incredible professionalism and compassion. They cared for my bunny with such gentleness, attention, and love that it made all the difference during such a delicate time.

They not only focused on the treatment but also on explaining everything clearly, answering every question, and providing emotional support throughout the process—something that is so appreciated when you're going through a difficult time with your pet.

It's clear they love what they do and that they truly care about the animals' well-being. For me, that's priceless.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart to the entire team for everything you've done for Aura 🤍 Especially to Evelio, for being so attentive to her condition 😊
I took my parakeet in for an emergency and they treated her right away. Super professional. I highly recommend them.

We took our lovebird Groot to the vet on Tuesday, May 5th. Dr. Sonsoles saw him and told us he was underweight and dehydrated. She ran some tests, including one on his crop because he was regurgitating a lot. They gave him an injection, sent us home with medication, and told us to keep an eye on him. We took excellent care of him, giving him all the medication. Yesterday, May 9th, he died. I would love to know why. What was the reason? She told us the bird was very ill because of his low weight and dehydration. What's going on here? I'm giving you one star because I can't give zero. Shouldn't he have stayed for at least a day if he was underweight? Or should they have checked his crop more thoroughly? My lovebird suffered because of this, so I absolutely do not recommend taking birds there, especially lovebirds. My mother took her parakeet there a couple of years ago, they prescribed treatment, and the parakeet died the next day. We are very frustrated and unhappy, and I hope no more birds die.
They have a very caring team. They did everything they could for my pet and supported me throughout the entire process. Again. I have nothing but kind words for all the staff at this center.

Alejandro treated me, and his service was outstanding. I took my hamster in because I didn't know what was wrong with him, and he's a very calming, empathetic, and professional veterinarian who clearly loves animals. Honestly, I couldn't have asked for a better vet; he was excellent.
Alejandro provided excellent care, patiently answering all my questions, and I'm so happy Niña has been discharged. 🐀 …

Many thanks to Sonsoles for her care and professionalism at the clinic. I took my rabbit Arko there with a very serious cardiac arrest, and although he ultimately didn't make it due to his critical condition, thank you for doing everything possible for him and for your kindness. Hugs.

Today, April 27, 2026, was my first day visiting this clinic for my guinea pig, Goku. I loved it! The receptionist was very kind and gentle, and the veterinarian, Evelio, is a sweetheart. He treated Goku with great care and tenderness, and she was delighted. They are a great team. Next visit is for surgery. Thank you; Goku and I are in your hands. I highly recommend this place for your exotic pets, wherever you live. They are special and cared for with so much love.
Incredible treatment for both the animal and me. I don't have much experience with veterinarians, but they welcomed us warmly and we're very happy. I recommend them 100%.
Absolutely delighted with this place!! We took our little Daxter there yesterday because he was sick, and the service was incredible, as was the way they treated our gerbil 💕💕. 10/10 …
Thank you so much, Vicente, for your feedback! We're here for anything you need with Tanula :)

Thank you for treating Alvina so professionally. She's much better, and that's thanks to you. Great veterinarians. Thank you, Alejandro, and thank you, Jose.
You're a fantastic team who, if they need to dedicate more time to help and explain everything, they do. A perfect ten!

Every time I go, I receive excellent service, but I want to highlight the attention I received from Alejandro, the surgeon. He was incredibly kind and patient, and he answered all our questions, making sure we understood everything perfectly.

I'm very happy with the clinic overall; they have a fantastic team of staff.

I haven't had a good experience with this clinic. I took two of my pets there at different times, and both died while sedated. Both from heart attacks, what a coincidence. That's what they told me when I went to pick them up. A rabbit and a parakeet.

I'm so grateful to this clinic, and amazed by their fantastic team! From the moment I walked in until I picked up my pet 🐰, they were incredibly communicative and patient. Their dedication is evident, and I've definitely felt much more at ease since meeting them, knowing my pet is in the best hands. Thank you, Evelio, Sonsoles, and the whole team 🫶🏼
If you have exotic pets, don't hesitate to go.

Xerjoff ♥️

It was the first time we had a serious problem with our rabbit and the treatment was wonderful, they always kept us informed regardless of whether it was during the week or the weekend, explaining the possibilities and letting us make the decisions. Sonsoles treated us brilliantly but I have to say that since it has been several days, the other veterinarians who informed us also did so knowing everything that was happening to our rabbit and updating all the information in an understandable way for us. Thank you very much

I've been taking my tortoises to Selvätica for over 10 years now. They are very professional and provide excellent care for our pets. I'm so glad we have such a high-quality exotic animal clinic in Valencia.

Thank you so much for everything.
Thank you so much, Antonio! ;-))

We are very happy with the service we received from Alvaro. He is not only friendly and approachable with us, but also with Ambar, our lop-eared bunny, and is incredibly professional. Thank you so much, you have become part of our family and we will definitely return to you whenever we have any problems 🫶🏼 …
Very good impression, I took my turtle there and the vet was professional.
I took my 19-year-old lovebird in for evaluation, and they gave me treatment to continue caring for him. Thank you.

I went in for a short time and they diagnosed and treated him very well; he recovered quickly. The staff is very kind, professional, and attentive. You can tell they're passionate about what they do. Thank you!
Highly recommended
They served us very quickly, they treated us very well
The service was unbeatable, everything was perfect.
Excellent service. I highly recommend them. Thank you so much for everything.
Everything was great, the human and professional qualities were outstanding. Thank you.

They took excellent care of Zeus (my rabbit) while he was hospitalized there, and I was kept very well informed about his condition throughout his stay. Even now that he's home, they still check in on him. I'm so grateful for all the kindness and support I received :)
Excellent service and wonderful people. We took my bunny in for an emergency and they managed to get her better. Evelio and Sonsoles were especially kind; I'm very grateful for their service.
Excellent clinic. 100% recommended. Very good service, especially from the veterinarian Evelio. Very kind and professional!

Very professional and attentive. I went at the end of last December with my parakeet, Blue, because I noticed her breathing was very rapid. I called and they saw her the same morning. Evelio examined her and did all the necessary tests (fecal analysis, X-ray, etc.), always informing me beforehand, including the costs, which I found reasonable. It turned out that Blue had several problems, one of them related to her diet (she was only eating seed mix, which is high in fatty acids, and some fruit). With the medication he prescribed and the food he recommended, she recovered quickly and is perfectly fine today (even though she's almost 9 years old, quite old for her species...). She even seems like she wants to start talking! :D Thank you so much, Evelio, for your concern and for offering me the best options. A big hug to the whole Selvätica team.

I'm delighted with this place. I went there a few months ago for an emergency with Bombón (a lop-eared rabbit) who was experiencing intestinal blockage, and thanks to them, Bombón is now well and happy again. The treatment was wonderful; thank you to the team for their patience with Bombón and for the excellent care she received during her stay. Of course, thank you to Evelio for the warm welcome and all the explanations he gave us. ♥️♥️
I took my Indian rabbit there and the service and professionalism were wonderful! 10/10
Excellent care for guinea pigs, we are very happy with Sevativa

I took my rabbit in because her head was tilted to one side, and she was spinning around. She wasn't eating or drinking; she was quite ill. Evelio treated her and gave me enough confidence to keep her for two days. She had infectious encephalitis, but now she's doing great! 🐇😍 She's improved so much. Everyone was wonderful, and I want to thank them all and send them a big hug, especially Evelio! 👍🫂 P.S. Highly recommended vet!

Terrible experience at Selvätica Valencia

We had our gerbil operated on at this clinic based on a recommendation and its good reviews. The surgery was performed by José Villora, and everything seemed to go well. However, the experience after the operation was disastrous. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic, mainly due to the lack of professionalism, transparency, and honesty of its veterinarians.

During the post-operative check-up with Álvaro, he barely examined the gerbil. It was clear he was afraid to handle it "in case it bit," and he failed to detect the infection that was still present after the surgery. Due to his negligence, our pet's condition worsened significantly.

On a second visit with veterinarian Alejandra, it was decided to perform a culture to analyze the infection. We paid €80 for this test, and after waiting two weeks (and having to call us ourselves, because they didn't even bother to inform us), the result was "sterile."
How can it be sterile if there was obvious pus? What kind of professional takes such a poor sample that it's useless? We were never informed that the result could be inconclusive or that the expense could be pointless.

And what can be said about them saying they'd call back to inform you of the result, even how the surgery itself went, and then never receiving the call? We've been calling ourselves, and the excuse is always that they're busy. They say they'll call you back in 10 minutes because they can't answer, and after much persistence, we finally got through to the vet, who is always busy.

I want to make it clear that we never refused anything: we always sought the animal's well-being, assuming all the necessary costs (more than €500). Even so, we feel like they're trying to take advantage of people, and we don't want anyone else to go through this.

Finally, we took the gerbil to another clinic specializing in exotic animals while we were on vacation. At the first check-up, they did everything correctly and eliminated the infection, all for much less money than at Selvätica.

You're lucky I didn't file a complaint with the consumer protection agency because I don't have enough evidence to prove the discrepancy between what I was told on the phone and what I was told in person. It's a shame I didn't record the conversation. But you all know perfectly well that things weren't handled properly here.

This only demonstrates the lack of professionalism at Selvätica. I feel cheated and scammed. This clinic is only interested in making money, not in the health of the animals.

Looking at other reviews, I've realized it's not a coincidence; they try to inflate the bills and aren't transparent with their diagnoses. You just have to filter the reviews and read a little.

It's a shame they have little competition in the exotic animal market, and that's why they take advantage of good people.

The surprise was that when we returned, they showed us the X-ray, but they had also done an ultrasound, a test we had made it clear we wouldn't have. At that moment, we thought maybe they had done it in good faith, but they told us we had to pay a "symbolic" fee… of €35. That's not symbolic; it's a hidden charge. The hamster has improved with the medication, but the follow-up care was terrible. They told us to call on Monday or Tuesday, we called on Tuesday, and they postponed the call twice. I waited from 10:00 AM for the supposed call that would be "less than 5 minutes" but never came. Today, tired of waiting, I went directly to the clinic and they gave me the prescription for the medication.

My feeling is that all they care about is money, not the animals. It's a shame there aren't many more exotic animal veterinarians, because you're almost forced to go here. That said, I do want to mention that the receptionist was very kind; in that respect, everything was fine.
